description: Creates a relationship (no relationshipId, source/targetEntityId required — FKs derived automatically) or updates one (relationshipId given). On update, sourceEnd/targetEnd take precedence; otherwise ends are re-derived from cardinality. onDelete/onUpdate set the FK referential actions ('noAction' reverts to the DB default); constraintName sets the FK constraint name (empty string reverts to auto-generation).

source.description: Target ERD — exactly one of a local file ({file}) or a server ERD ({erdId})

name: upsert_relationship
